scripts.lint: eslint app components data functions lib scripts --max-warnings=0
scripts.cf:dev: npm run build && npx wrangler pages dev out
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler pages deploy out --project-name ai-tools-directory
scripts.db:migrate:local: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply ai-tools-directory --local
scripts.db:seed:local: npx tsx scripts/seed.ts && npx wrangler d1 execute ai-tools-directory --local --file=scripts/seed.sql
scripts.db:seed:remote: npx tsx scripts/seed.ts && npx wrangler d1 execute ai-tools-directory --remote --file=scripts/seed.sql
